people.name: Malta
people.line: An island where Paul was shipwrecked

translations.web: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.
translations.bsb: Once we were safely ashore, we learned that the island was called Malta.
translations.kjv: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
